business_summary: Shikoku Kasei Holdings Corporation engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of chemical products and housing materials in Japan and internationally. It offers carbon disulfide and hydrogen sulfide, sodium sulfate and carbonate, insoluble sulfur, and chlorinated isocyanurates; organic solderability preservative; chemical adhesion process; microetching solution; imidazole type and adduct type latent curing agents; adhesion and heat resistance improver; isocyanuric acid derivatives; glycoluril derivatives; cationic curing materials; and THEIC materials. The company provides automatic chlorine feeders, bacteria enzymes, and urinary calculus removers; and industrial chemicals, pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, fertilizers, and agricultural chemicals. In addition, it offers housing materials comprising interior finishing and paving materials, and residential and landscape exterior products. Further, the company is involved in the design, production, development, and installation of shutters and other retail outlet fixtures, as well as provides technical services; development and sale of computer software; management of computer systems; operation of the Mosburger chain of hamburger shops; sale of giftware and daily use products; design, installation, and maintenance management of water treatment for sewage and septic tanks; construction of drainage pipe connection; inspection and cleaning of water storage tanks; collection and transportation of general and industrial waste materials; provision of information services; damage-insurance and life-insurance agency; packaging and transportation; and housing renovation and solar photovoltaic generation activities. Additionally, it offers environmental measurement authentication, and quality testing of drinking water services; construction materials; and design and construction of related facilities. Shikoku Kasei Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Marugame, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Shikoku Kasei Holdings Corporation은 일본 및 해외에서 화학 제품 및 주택 자재의 연구 개발, 제조 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이황화탄소와 황화수소, 황산나트륨과 탄산염, 불용성 유황, 염소화 이소시아누레이트를 제공합니다. 유기 납땜성 보존제; 화학적 접착 공정; 마이크로에칭 용액; 이미다졸형 및 부가물형 잠재성 경화제; 접착성 및 내열성 향상제; 이소시아누르산 유도체; 글리콜우릴 유도체; 양이온 경화 재료; 및 THEIC 자료. 이 회사는 자동 염소 공급 장치, 박테리아 효소 및 요로 결석 제거제를 제공합니다. 공업용 화학물질, 의약품, 의약외품, 비료, 농약 등을 취급합니다. 또한, 내부 마감재, 포장재 등을 포함하는 주택자재, 주거용 및 조경용 외장재 등을 공급하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 셔터 및 기타 소매점 설비의 설계, 생산, 개발 및 설치에 참여하고 기술 서비스를 제공합니다. 컴퓨터 소프트웨어 개발 및 판매; 컴퓨터 시스템 관리; 모스버거 체인 운영
